info.name: SaloFresh — Customer Journey
info.description:
End-to-end Postman collection covering the complete SaloFresh customer/user journey, in the order a real customer would move through the app:

1. Auth — register, verify OTP, login (captures tokens), refresh, profile check, password flows
2. Profile & Preferences — profile, addresses, device tokens, preferred stylist
3. Discover Salons — categories, locations, salon search/detail, services, employees, reviews, favorites, recently viewed
4. Slots & Booking — availability, coupon preview, create/list/detail/reschedule/cancel booking
5. Payments & Wallet — initiate/confirm payment, invoices, wallet balance/top-up/history, reward points
6. Reviews — multi-criteria review create/list/update/report
7. Memberships & Gift Cards — plans, purchase + confirm, subscriptions, gift card purchase/balance/redeem
8. Family & Waitlist — family member CRUD, join/list/leave waitlist
9. Chat & Support — support conversations/messages, support ticket lifecycle
10. Privacy & Misc — GDPR data requests, feature flags, calendar export, guest booking, and logout (always last)

All requests target {{baseUrl}}/api/v1/... Run '01 Auth > Login' first (or let the collection runner execute folders top-to-bottom) so {{accessToken}} is populated for the bearer-auth requests that follow.

item.name: 01 Auth

request.description: Register a new customer account (public, no role required). Creates the account; an email/phone verification OTP is sent.
Verify the registration OTP for email/phone verification (public). In a real environment, use the OTP delivered via email/SMS instead of this placeholder value.
Resend a verification OTP to the given identifier (public).
Login with email/phone + password (public). Captures accessToken/refreshToken used by the rest of the collection.
Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access/refresh token pair (public).
Get the currently authenticated user's account summary. Requires any authenticated role.
Request an OTP to reset a forgotten password (public).
Reset password using a verified OTP (public).
Change password for the currently authenticated customer.

item.description: Registration, OTP verification, login and token lifecycle. Login captures accessToken/refreshToken used by every later request. Logout / Logout-All deliberately live at the very end of '10 Privacy & Misc' so tokens stay valid while the rest of the journey runs.

item.name: 02 Profile & Preferences

request.description: Get the current customer's full profile (wallet balance, membership level, totals). Requires authenticated user.
Update the current customer's profile fields. Requires authenticated user.
Upload/replace the current customer's profile picture (multipart). Requires authenticated user.
List the current customer's saved addresses. Requires authenticated user.
Add a new saved address for the current customer. Requires authenticated user.

request.description: Mark a saved address as the default address for the current customer.
Delete a saved address owned by the current customer.
Register (or re-register) a push notification device token for the current customer.
Unregister a push notification device token for the current customer.
Get the current customer's preferred/favorite stylist, if any.
Set the current customer's preferred stylist for quick re-booking.
Clear the current customer's preferred stylist.

item.description: Authenticated customer's own profile, addresses, push-notification device tokens and preferred stylist. Run after login.

item.name: 03 Discover Salons

request.description: List all active service categories (public).
Get a single service category by id (public).
List all countries used to populate address/salon forms (public).
List states for a given country (public).
List cities for a given state (public).
Search publicly visible, approved and active salons by city/rating/price/gender-type/geo (public). Captures the first result's id/slug for later requests.
Get full public detail of a salon by its slug, optionally with distanceKm when lat/lng are passed (public).
Search ACTIVE services across all salons by category/price/salon (public discovery endpoint).

query.description: owner-only flag to include inactive services

request.description: List ACTIVE services offered by a salon (public). Captures the first service id.
Get a single salon service by id (public).
List employees/stylists for a salon, optionally filtered by status/service (public, used during booking). Captures the first employee id.
Get employee/stylist detail (public, used during booking).
List an employee's visible reviews (public).
List a salon's visible reviews (public).
Get the aggregate multi-criteria rating breakdown for a salon (public).
Add a salon to the current customer's favorites.
List the current customer's favorite salons.
List the current customer's recently viewed salons, most recent first.
Remove a salon from the current customer's favorites.

item.description: Public browsing (categories, locations, salon search/detail, services, employees, reviews) plus the authenticated favorites and recently-viewed lists.

item.name: 04 Slots & Booking

query.description: ISO date to check availability for

request.description: Get available booking slots for a salon on a given date, optionally filtered by employee/services (public).
Preview a coupon's discount before booking; returns valid=false with a friendly message instead of an HTTP error. Requires authenticated customer.
Create a new booking for the current customer. Captures the created booking id.

body.raw:
{
  "salonId": "{{salonId}}",
  "employeeId": "{{employeeId}}",
  "appointmentDate": "2026-09-15",
  "startTime": "10:30",
  "serviceIds": [
    "{{serviceId}}"
  ],
  "couponCode": "WELCOME10",
  "paymentMethod": "UPI",
  "notes": "Please use a chair near the window"
}

request.description: List bookings for the current customer, optionally filtered by status/date range.
Get a booking by its numeric id or booking number.
Pre-fill a new booking request from a prior completed booking.
Reschedule an existing booking to a new date/time (and optionally a new employee).
Cancel an existing booking, with an optional reason.

item.description: Slot availability, coupon preview, booking creation and lifecycle (list, detail, rebook template, reschedule, cancel). Cancel is placed last per the requested journey order — run it only if you want to end the demo booking, since Payments/Reviews below reference the same {{bookingId}}.

item.name: 05 Payments & Wallet

request.description: Initiate payment for a booking's pending payment. Captures the created paymentId.
Confirm/capture a previously initiated gateway payment (ignored fields for CASH).
Get a payment by id.
List the current customer's payments.
Get a structured JSON invoice for a successful payment.
Download a PDF rendering of the invoice for a successful payment. Response is binary (application/pdf).
Get the current customer's wallet balance.
Paginated wallet transaction history for the current customer.
Top up the wallet; CASH is settled immediately, gateway methods require a follow-up POST /payments/{id}/confirm call.
Get the current customer's reward point history, paginated.
Get the current customer's reward point balance.

item.description: Payment initiation/confirmation for the booking created above, invoices, wallet balance/top-up/history and reward points.

item.name: 06 Reviews

request.description: Create a multi-criteria review for a completed appointment. Captures the created reviewId.

body.raw:
{

  "cleanlinessRating": 4,
  "serviceQualityRating": 5,

  "comment": "Wonderful experience, the stylist was excellent and the salon was spotless."
}

request.description: Upload and attach an image to the current customer's own review (multipart).
List reviews written by the current customer.
Update the rating/comment of the current customer's own review.

body.raw:
{
  "salonRating": 5,
  "employeeRating": 5,
  "cleanlinessRating": 5,
  "serviceQualityRating": 5,

request.description: Report a review as inappropriate (any authenticated user; used here to demonstrate the moderation-reporting flow on the customer's own review).

item.description: Customer-authored multi-criteria review lifecycle: create, attach image, list mine, update, report.

item.name: 07 Memberships & Gift Cards

request.description: List the active membership plans offered by a salon (public). Captures the first plan id.
Purchase a membership plan; for CASH/gateway methods this returns details needed to finish confirmation. Captures the paymentId.
Verify a gateway payment (or finalize a CASH payment) and activate the membership subscription. Captures the subscriptionId.
List the current customer's membership subscriptions.
Get the current customer's active membership subscription usable at a salon, if any.
Purchase a gift card; WALLET is settled immediately, gateway methods require a follow-up confirm call. Captures the gift card code when issued immediately.

body.raw:
{
  "amount": 1000.0,
  "paymentMethod": "WALLET",
  "recipientName": "Ananya Rao",
  "recipientEmail": "ananya.rao@example.com",
  "recipientPhone": "9876500011",
  "message": "Happy Birthday! Enjoy a spa day on me.",
  "validityDays": 365
}

request.description: Confirm a gateway-method gift card purchase and issue the gift card. Not needed for the WALLET sample above (already issued); kept here to demonstrate the gateway-method flow.
Publicly check a gift card's balance and status by code (public).
List gift cards purchased by the current customer.
Redeem a gift card in full into the current customer's wallet.

item.description: Browse and purchase salon membership plans (with payment confirm) and platform gift cards (purchase, public balance check, list mine, redeem).

item.name: 08 Family & Waitlist

request.description: List the current customer's family/dependent profiles.
Add a new family member for the current customer, to book on their behalf. Captures the created id.
Get a single family member owned by the current customer.
Update a family member owned by the current customer.
Remove a family member owned by the current customer.
Join the waitlist for a fully booked (or preferred) salon/employee/date. Captures the created waitlist entry id.
List the current customer's own waitlist entries.
Cancel the current customer's own waitlist entry.

item.description: Family/dependent profile CRUD used for booking on behalf of others, plus joining/leaving a salon notify-me waitlist.

item.name: 09 Chat & Support
Get Or Create Salon Support Conversation

request.description: Get or create the current customer's SALON_SUPPORT conversation with a salon. Captures the conversationId. Note: live message sending happens over the STOMP WebSocket endpoint (ChatWebSocketController), which has no plain-REST equivalent and is therefore not represented here.

item.name: Get Or Create Platform Support Conversation

request.description: Get or create the current customer's PLATFORM_SUPPORT conversation.
List the current customer's conversations.
Paginated message history for a conversation (participants only).
Mark all unread messages in a conversation as read by the current customer.
Close a conversation (participants only).
Raise a new platform support ticket. Captures the created ticketId.
List the current customer's support tickets.
Get a support ticket owned by the current customer.
Add a follow-up message to the current customer's own support ticket.
List messages on a support ticket owned by the current customer (internal notes hidden from non-admins).

item.description: In-app chat conversation history/lifecycle and the platform support ticket flow.

item.name: 10 Privacy & Misc

request.description: Raise a new GDPR/DPDP data export or account-deletion request for the current customer.
List the current customer's own GDPR/DPDP data subject requests.
Get one of the current customer's own data subject requests.
List all currently active feature flags as a key-value map, for client-side use. Requires any authenticated user (not a public endpoint, but not admin-restricted either).
Download the booking as an .ics calendar file (owner or admin only). Response is binary (text/calendar).
Get a pre-filled Google Calendar 'add event' link for the booking (owner or admin only).
Book an appointment without a full account (public). Resolves/creates a lightweight guest identity and returns a real access/refresh token pair for managing the booking afterward.

  "startTime": "16:00",
  "serviceIds": [
    "{{serviceId}}"
  ],
  "couponCode": "",
  "paymentMethod": "CASH",
  "notes": "First time visiting, please call before arrival"

request.description: Find a guest booking using the phone number used at booking time plus the booking number as a shared secret (public, read-only, no token required).
OPTIONAL / DESTRUCTIVE - deactivates the current customer's account. Skip this during a normal full-collection run; only run intentionally at the very end of a test cycle.
OPTIONAL / DESTRUCTIVE - soft-deletes the current customer's account. Skip this during a normal full-collection run; only run intentionally at the very end of a test cycle.
LOGOUT - revokes the current refresh token and blacklists the current access token. Run this LAST, after every other request in the collection, since it invalidates {{accessToken}}.
LOGOUT - revokes every refresh token for the current user across all devices. The very last request in the whole collection.

item.description: GDPR/DPDP data subject requests, feature flags, calendar export, guest (no-account) booking, and — as the final two items of the entire collection — logout / logout-all.
